title: RSI-PDEbench: A Benchmark for Self-Improving Agents in PDE Solving
abstract: arXiv:2611.14949v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Identifying and solving partial differential equations (PDEs) from sampled solution data often requires substantial expert effort in equation discovery, coefficient estimation, and numerical solver configuration, especially under noise and distribution shifts. Can large language model (LLM) agents automate this workflow accurately and efficiently? To investigate this question, we introduce \bench{}, a benchmark of 1,001 cases spanning 42 equation templates, including both classical and fractional PDEs. It provides three evaluation settings: Full evaluates performance on noise-free solution data; Noisy tests robustness to Gaussian noise with an RMS equal to 50\% of the clean-signal RMS; and Hard-OOD tests challenging out-of-distribution generalization to unseen equation templates and shifted coefficient ranges. We further introduce RSI-PDE, a recursively self-improving agent harness that shortlists candidate equations by residual loss, us

translated_title: RSI-PDEbench：面向偏微分方程求解的自我提升智能体基准测试
translated_abstract: 从采样的解数据中识别和求解偏微分方程（PDE）通常需要专家在方程发现、系数估计和数值求解器配置方面投入大量精力，尤其是在存在噪声和分布偏移的情况下。大型语言模型（LLM）智能体能否准确且高效地自动化这一工作流程？为研究这一问题，我们提出了RSI-PDEbench，这是一个包含1,001个案例、涵盖42个方程模板的基准测试，其中包括经典PDE和分数阶PDE。该基准提供三种评估设置：Full评估智能体在无噪声解数据上的性能；Noisy测试其对高斯噪声的鲁棒性（噪声RMS等于干净信号RMS的50%）；Hard-OOD则测试具有挑战性的分布外泛化能力，即对未见过的方程模板以及发生偏移的系数范围的泛化。我们进一步提出了RSI-PDE，一个递归自我提升的智能体框架，它通过残差损失筛选候选方程，从而使……
tldr: 该论文提出了包含1,001个案例、42个方程模板并提供Full、Noisy、Hard-OOD三种评估设置的基准RSI-PDEbench，以及通过残差损失筛选候选方程的递归自我提升智能体框架RSI-PDE，用于评估和提升LLM智能体在噪声与分布偏移下自动识别和求解偏微分方程的能力。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces RSI-PDEbench, a benchmark of 1,001 cases spanning 42 equation templates with Full, Noisy, and Hard-OOD evaluation settings, along with RSI-PDE, a recursively self-improving agent harness that shortlists candidate equations by residual loss to enable LLM agents to automatically identify and solve PDEs under noise and distribution shifts.
